analyzed_vuln.description: Double-free caused by ownership confusion between config-map MULT string entries and input property KV entries. In the fuzzer path, a KV value (allocated in flb_kv_item_create via flb_sds_create_len) is inserted into config map processing, and for FLB_CONFIG_MAP_MULT + FLB_CONFIG_MAP_STR, map value entries end up holding the same SDS pointer as the KV value instead of a duplicated string. flb_config_map_destroy() (via destroy_map_val()) frees that SDS first, then flb_kv_release() frees the same SDS again in flb_kv_item_destroy(), triggering ASan double-free.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In tests/internal/fuzzers/config_map_fuzzer.c, LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates a property list with flb_kv_item_create(&prop, key, value), then calls flb_config_map_set / flb_config_map_properties_check and finally flb_config_map_destroy(map) followed by flb_kv_release(&prop). When input selects a MULT string config key (e.g., 'mult_string' in config_map_mult) and provides a value, config map internals store/alias the KV SDS pointer in map MULT values. Destruction order then frees the same allocation twice: first in flb_config_map_destroy()->destroy_map_val(), then in flb_kv_release()->flb_kv_item_destroy().
